data.name: Ezher
data.gender_notes: Ezher is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Azhar' meaning 'strong, brave, and fearless'. This name is associated with those who possess a powerful and unyielding spirit. The name Ezher carries the meaning “Strong, Brave, Fearless” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Ezher usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave, fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a deep connection to the divine, inspiring courage and fearlessness in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Ezher belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Brave, Fearless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ezher total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
